title: ilye(1): Python UDP parser — move endpoint validation out of UdpDatagram.from_bytes into address-policy module
description: Slice 1 of project-LICHEN-worker6-ilye (Rule 255 RX byte-preserving decision, Mark 2026-08-30). UdpDatagram.from_bytes keeps framing + UDP checksum verification; endpoint address validation (loopback, IPv4-mapped, unspecified, multicast source, destination scope) moves out of the parser into the address-policy module so it can be applied at origination/forwarding only. Lands BEFORE slice 2 (python decode path) which depends on this refactor.
